verdict.rationale: Exa's pricing page offers sign-up credits plus $10 in free credits every month with no payment method required (exa-docs-34, exa-docs-43). A community user confirms signing up for a trial account and prototyping an agentic chatbot against the search API (exa-comm-3). Keyless MCP access (exa-docs-31) and an API Playground (exa-docs-59) add further low-friction entry points. Missing for 10: consistent documentation of the onboarding bonus amount ($20 vs $10 across pricing snippets), and documented rate limits or quotas that apply to free-credit accounts.
